about: Labelled queries for semantic search (semantic plan T9). Drawn from agents/knowledge.db as of 2026-10-29 and labelled by the model that wrote them from record titles and a reading of the candidate rows; one person's judgement of one corpus, a guard against regressions and a way to compare models, not a general benchmark. A relevant row is named by a record ref, an observation substring or a concept name, so the labels survive id renumbering. no_answer queries have nothing in the corpus that answers them: a good search returns nothing for them.
